item.description: - The free trial is gone. OpenWispr now needs a license key before it can dictate or record a meeting. This applies to new installs and to updated ones, including Macs that were on a trial. - Everything you already captured stays readable without a key: dictation history, meeting transcripts and summaries. - A license is $15 once for one Mac, with a 7-day money-back guarantee, no questions. Buy at https://charandeepkapoor.com/openwispr#pricing and paste the key in the License screen. - Downloads now come with your purchase instead of GitHub. The source stays MIT, and a build you make from source needs no key. - This build is self-signed, not notarized.
